description: Correspondence from Margretta Dietrich to the other Stewart Sisters: 1.	Letter from Dietrich to Mabel Stewart Ludlum, April 12, 1933. 2. Letter from Dietrich to Delia Stewart Lewis, undated. 3. Two letters from Dietrich to Ethel Stewart Barr, undated. Correspondence to and from Dietrich and to and from Various Correspondents: 1. Postcard from Marie Armengaud to Margretta Dietrich, Dec. 24, 1937. 2. Postcard from Margretta Dietrich to Helen Grant, Jan. 5, 1941. 3. Letter from Paul [no last name] to Margretta Dietrich, Sept. 18, 1941. 4. Letter from Margretta Dietrich to Kennth Chapman, Feb. 23, 1956.
title: Margretta Dietrich to and from various correspondents
